execution_timezone_rationale: Retain existing generator/evaluator TZ consistently; scheduling and quota use Asia/Bangkok until server verification.

algorithm_parameters.objective: minimize frequency of observed fixed behavior, not coverage

target_policy: All classes modified by each selected fix. Eligibility is intersection of fixed/buggy declaration signatures and common fixture types. No buggy behavior, patch contents, or triggering test supplied for generation.
context_policy: Same fixed-source/API/build context and target list for all four methods; fresh KKU request per job; fixed source only; no execution/compile logs sent to AI.

compatibility_allowlist: organize extracted Java files by declared package
processing_policy.semantic_repairs: Require new protocol condition and disclosed raw/processed delta; not raw KKU output.

usable_policy: Nonempty meaningful assertions and executed target; compile succeeds; identical suite passes fixed twice; buggy and fixed target-class coverage measured; detected=false is valid.
historical_policy: 17-bug historical cohorts remain separate; never imported as API854 primary observations.
